item.title: Israel’s Zim shipping company inks $4.2 billion takeover deal by German giant
item.description: As part of the deal, an Israeli container liner firm will be formed to securely operate global shipping trade routes to Israel; Hapag-Lloyd commits to retain Zim employees The post Israel’s Zim shipping company inks $4.2 billion takeover deal by German giant appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Trump ally to ToI: Ayatollah staying in power would be ‘strategic victory for Iran’
item.description: Visiting Israel day before fresh nuke talks, GOP Sen. Graham says US decision striking on Iran is ‘weeks, not months’ away; Trump: Iran doesn't want consequences of not taking deal The post Trump ally to ToI: Ayatollah staying in power would be ‘strategic victory for Iran’ appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Second round of high-stakes talks between US, Iran to be held in Geneva today
item.description: Trump says he'll be indirectly involved in negotiations and that Iran doesn't want to face consequences of not taking deal * Smotrich says he'd tell daughter not to enlist in IDF The post Second round of high-stakes talks between US, Iran to be held in Geneva today appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Did the founder of Hadassah – Israel’s ‘mother’ – support a one-state solution?
item.description: In her biography, 'Henrietta Szold: Hadassah and the Zionist Dream,' author Francine Klagsbrun shows how the acclaimed activist fought against misogyny and for the rights of all children The post Did the founder of Hadassah – Israel’s ‘mother’ – support a one-state solution? appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: ‘Godfather’ and ‘Apocalypse Now’ actor Robert Duvall dead at 95
item.description: Blunt-talking, glitz-averse Oscar winner also played Adolf Eichmann in 1996 film on Nazi war criminal's capture and mysterious recluse Boo Radley in 'To Kill a Mockingbird' The post ‘Godfather’ and ‘Apocalypse Now’ actor Robert Duvall dead at 95 appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Spike Lee wears pro-Palestinian outfit to NBA All-Star Game featuring 1st Israeli player
item.description: Mavericks guard Kyrie Irving wears “PRESS” t-shirt dedicated to journalists killed in Gaza, with some pro-Israel fans claiming wardrobe choice meant to target Deni Avdija The post Spike Lee wears pro-Palestinian outfit to NBA All-Star Game featuring 1st Israeli player appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US conducts 1st air transport of nuclear microreactor in bid to show tech’s viability
item.description: Device flown on cargo plane from California to Utah to demonstrate potential to quickly deploy nuclear power for military and civilian use The post US conducts 1st air transport of nuclear microreactor in bid to show tech’s viability appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Israeli police say they’ll deploy around Temple Mount compound during Ramadan
item.description: PA says it was informed that permits for Palestinians will be restricted to men over 55 and women over 50, mirroring last year's criteria; Waqf barred from carrying out preparations The post Israeli police say they’ll deploy around Temple Mount compound during Ramadan appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Lebanon says next phase of Hezbollah disarmament to take around 4 months
item.description: Minister sats timeframe is extendable, depending on available capabilities, hindrances on the ground and attacks from Israel, which rejects that 1st phase has been fully completed The post Lebanon says next phase of Hezbollah disarmament to take around 4 months appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: High Court to hold hearing on Western Wall egalitarian services for first time in years
item.description: Liberal Jewish groups seek to ensure full rights for egalitarian prayers despite ultra-Orthodox opposition, long after government nixed compromise on the matter The post High Court to hold hearing on Western Wall egalitarian services for first time in years appeared first on The Times of Israel.
